rows.notes: The cited document is a narrative review (labelled 'Review' in the journal header; objective stated in Section 1 as a bibliographical synthesis) of partial root-zone drying irrigation. It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs; all results on water productivity, salinity and root activity are compiled from other studies (Tables 1-4). Since Q1 is 'no', Q2-Q9 are 'no'. The review does discuss drip-related salinity behaviour (Section 8, citing Hanson and May 2010, Abdelraouf and Ragab 2018, Kaman et al. 2006) and PRD water-use gains (Table 2, Section 5), which loosely relate to the claim about alignment of wetting front, salt front and root activity, but none of this is the authors' own evidence.
